==Biography==
===2015 Season===
Lee "'''Scout'''" Ye-chan joined [[SK Telecom T1]] during the 2015 preseason as a mid lane substitute; however, the team used only [[Faker]] and [[Easyhoon]] for the entirety of the 2015 season. 

===2016 Season===
Scout made his debut at the [[2015 LoL KeSPA Cup]] against [[ESC Ever|Ever]] in a semifinal BO3. After losing game 1, SKT subbed him out for Faker but ended up losing the second game as well and were eliminated. Scout stayed with SKT for the 2016 [[LCK/2016 Season/Spring Season|LCK Season]] but was removed from the roster after the first half of the round robin<ref>[http://esports.dailygame.co.kr/view.php?ud=2016022515445835130 <nowiki>[롤챔스 스프링] SKT '스카우트' 이예찬 제외 등 2R 로스터</nowiki>] ''esports.dailygame.co.kr''</ref> In March, Scout left SK Telecom T1 to join [[EDward Gaming]] as a mid laner. <ref>[http://www.weibo.com/5235726837/DnAm7fpDp?from=page_1006065235726837_profile&wvr=6&mod=weibotime&type=comment#_rnd1462926811931 <nowiki> Edward Gaming's Weibo Post (Chinese)</nowiki>] ''weibo.com'' </ref>

During the midseason offseason, [[PawN]] stepped down as EDG's starting midlaner, and Scout was announced to take his place. <ref>[http://www.thescoreesports.com/news/7831 The Score's Article] ''thescoreesports.com''</ref> The Summer Split was the start to EDG's resurgence as the team finished with an undefeated 16-0 regular season record. In the [[LPL/2016_Season/Summer_Playoffs|2016 LPL Summer Playoffs]] EDG defeated [[Team WE]] 3-2 in the semifinals which set them up for a rematch against [[Royal Never Give Up]]. In clean fashion, EDG defeated RNG in a 3-0 sweep and reclaimed the LPL championship. This also qualified them for the [[2016 Season World Championship]] as China's #1 seed.

At Worlds, EDG was drawn in Group C along with [[H2k-Gaming]], [[ahq e-Sports Club]] and [[INTZ e-Sports]]. Despite being a favorite in the group, they dropped a game to H2K and INTZ which forced a tiebreaker between them an H2K for 1st and 2nd place. After they lost the tiebreaker and ended 2nd, they were drawn against the tournament favorites ROX Tigers in the Quarterfinals. Despite winning a game, EDG was defeated 1-3 and knocked out of Worlds. Post-worlds, EDG attended the [[Demacia_Cup/2016_Season|2016 Demacia Cup]] and won the event after taking down [[Royal Never Give Up]] 3-1 in the semifinals and [[I May]] 3-0 in the finals.

===2017 Season===

After PawN's departure from EDG, Scout was chosen as the full time starting mid laner for the team. EDG failed to defend their LPL title in the [[LPL/2017_Season/Spring_Season|2017 LPL Spring Season]] and lost 1-3 to RNG in the [[LPL/2017_Season/Spring_Playoffs|2017 Spring Playoffs]] semifinals. They placed 3rd after taking down [[OMG]] 3-2 in the third place match. Summer was much better for EDG and Scout in particular was an MVP worthy player. He finished 1st in the regular season MVP awards, just above [[Xiaohu]]. In the end EDG reclaimed their throne as LPL champions after taking down RNG 3-2 in the finals of the playoffs.

EDG's [[2017 Season World Championship]] participation wasn't so stellar. Although Scout had moments of brilliance, he was one of the main factors behind some of EDG's key losses by being overaggressive and not showing enough respect to his opponents. Ultimately EDG was knocked out of Worlds in the group stage and finished tied for 3rd place with [[ahq e-Sports Club]].

== Trivia ==
<tabber>
General Trivia=
===General Trivia===
* Speaks Chinese fluently.
* Has an older brother.
* Famous for applying for tryouts at [[SK Telecom T1]] in season 5, but was denied the midlane spot. He instead went to [[EDward Gaming]] where he spent most of his career. 
** For this reason, he's sometimes called the "Chinese Faker".
* During his time in [[SK Telecom T1]], his teammates, and even coach [[kkOma]] often dote on him, as he was the youngest member of the team.
* Has multiple nicknames from Chinese fans.
** Little Junior (小学弟): He was once the substitute for [[Faker]], and so the casters often named him as "the junior to [[Faker]]" when he first arrived in the LPL.
** Lee Duo-duo (李多多): Fans often teased him that he won games "again and again" without him needing to play back in his days at [[SK Telecom T1]]. The Korean for "again" is "또" (ddo), which has a similar pronunciation to "多" (duo).
** Zoe Lee (李佐伊): Often has carrying performances when playing matches with {{ci|Zoe}}.
** Harvard Mid-laner (哈佛中单): His older brother once said that Scout would be in the level of Harvard in terms of game skills, to convince his family for Scout to become a professional player.
* Gained Chinese residency in 2021, a rare feat for a foreign player as the LPL has some of the strictest residency rules.
|-|
